name: Dead Air at the Neon BBS
description: A retro BBS gateway has gone quiet after its night-shift operator vanished. Recover the lost transmission record from the gateway. This challenge runs on the lab network: scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.

tasks.name: Recover the night transmission
tasks.description: The campus archive needs the missing transmission record from the retro BBS gateway. The challenge runs on the lab network: scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199. Recover the record.
hints: One listener stays quiet until you send it something it understands. Compare responses across the open ports.
Try a Redis protocol greeting on the odd listener; a PING response can identify it even without a banner.
After recognizing Redis, inspect the BBS transmission record stored under its night-shift key.
